source: paper_search (20 international + 3 Indonesian sources); see search_20261101.md for the query log and per-source status
limitations: Metadata-only. No full text was read in this pass; every quantitative value in the search log is abstract-reported and must be re-audited before it enters a paper.
arXiv answered HTTP 429 or timed out on every query, so arXiv identifiers here were reached through OpenAlex/OpenReview mirrors and still need arxiv.org/abs verification.
author is null where the index did not report an author list; it was left null rather than guessed.
Anonymous OpenReview submissions are recorded with authors null by design, not by omission.
Entries whose title carries a '(title as indexed; verify on arXiv)' note were reconstructed from the index and are not yet confirmed on arXiv.
